image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate (cuirass) resting against a dark red fabric background. The armor features a polished silver-colored steel front plate with visible hammer marks and reflections. It is bordered by brass or bronze trim along the neck, armholes, and bottom edge, secured with rivets. Leather shoulder straps are attached to the upper corners.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'shield' or 'helmet'.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections and ensure no AI-generated smearing in the high-contrast areas.
To verify the physical connectivity between the leather straps, brass trim, and steel plate, ensuring no floating elements.

focus_areas: Reflectivity consistency on the steel surface
Physical attachment points of the leather straps
Edge sharpness between the brass trim and steel plate
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the lack of ornamental details disqualifies it from the 'breastplate' class or if it fits a simpler variant. Check for any subtle warping in the reflection patterns that might indicate AI generation.
